The '''''Thaere Interceptor''''' was a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 gunship]] that saw service with the [[Thaereian military|Navy of Thaere]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Toric Bisilt]] was assigned to serve on it for a time and it participated in the [[Blockade of the Cularin system]].
